parts.text: Outline one genetic explanation of schizophrenia and delusional disorder.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Describe the study by Freeman (2008) on symptom assessment of schizophrenia using
virtual reality.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Explain one strength and one weakness of the study by Freeman.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Describe the treatment and management of anxiety disorders (systematic desensitisation,
applied tension, cognitive-behavioural therapy).

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Evaluate the treatment and management of anxiety disorders (systematic desensitisation,
applied tension, cognitive-behavioural therapy), including a discussion of determinism versus
free-will. 
Psychology and consumer behaviour

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Outline the black box (stimulus-response) model of buying a product.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Atalay et al. (2012) carried out three studies on attention and shelf position (Study 1A,
Study 1B and Study 2).
Describe one of these studies.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Discuss the reliability of the study by Atalay et al. that you described in part (b).

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Describe what psychologists have discovered about types of advertising and advertising
techniques (advertising media, marketing mix models, product placement in films).

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Evaluate what psychologists have discovered about types of advertising and advertising
techniques (advertising media, marketing mix models, product placement in films), including
a discussion on practical applications. 
Psychology and health

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Identify two of the stages in the model of delay in seeking treatment (Safer, 1979).

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Aleem and Ajarim (1995) conducted a case study on a 22-year-old female university student
who was diagnosed with Munchausen syndrome.
Outline two findings from this case study.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Discuss the validity of the case study by Aleem and Ajarim.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Describe what psychologists have discovered about types of non-adherence to medical
advice, reasons why patients do not adhere, and the health belief model.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Evaluate what psychologists have discovered about types of non-adherence to medical
advice, reasons why patients do not adhere, and the health belief model, including a
discussion about individual and situational explanations. 
Psychology and organisations

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Janis (1971) suggested strategies to avoid groupthink.
Outline one of these strategies.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Describe two strategies to manage group conflict in organisations (Thomas, 1976).

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Explain two problems psychologists may have when investigating group conflict.

parts.text:
Describe theories of job satisfaction (two factor theory, job characteristics theory, techniques
of job design).

parts.text:
Evaluate theories of job satisfaction (two factor theory, job characteristics theory, techniques
of job design), including a discussion about reductionism versus holism.
